en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a riverside or lakeside landscape with trees, a small monument crowned by a large bird (likely an eagle) statue on a rocky hill, and a truss bridge in the background. Printed captions in red read "Grand-Duché de Finlande" at the top and "Tampere. Tammerfors" at the bottom. There is handwritten cursive text along the right margin and a narrow vertical decorative bar on the left.
